pairs.target: tǎ wéi bèi mùhé , mǐlā dài chǐ hé túbǎn , yīwén bǎ zhǐjiá zài liǎngkuài báobǎn zhījiān .
pairs.english: Tavi carried the wooden box on his back; Mira brought a ruler and drawing board; Iven sandwiched the paper between two thin boards.

pairs.english: They did not take the suspension bridge from last time again. The old warehouse stood on another branch road that wound along the mountainside, far longer than it looked on the map.

pairs.english: Reaching a treeless opening on the slope, Tavi saw distant water like a bent knife: just a narrow line of brightness, with a great expanse still hidden in shadow.

pairs.english: Lasha said Reedbay often had light like this in the morning, but the land was flat: you had to climb onto a roof to see far.

pairs.hanzi: 伊文想问那边的船怎样认路，前头已经到了岔口，奈蕾让他们先看路牌，问题便留到后面。

pairs.english: Iven looked down at the empty space drawn on his own map, moved two steps aside, and added a narrow path beside it. He did not ask why the water carrier was missing from the timetable.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文低头看看自己图上画的空位，挪开两步，在旁边添了一条窄道。他没有问时刻表上为什么没写挑水的人。

pairs.english: A cart loaded with small bags came out of the warehouse. Its wheels crossed the doorway with two different sounds, the first dull and the second sharp.
pairs.hanzi: 仓里出来一辆装满小袋的车，车轮压过门口，发出两声不同的响。前一声闷，后一声脆。

pairs.english: Mira asked whether this was where it jolted. The manager said yes; some carts jolted worse, while empty ones barely showed it. A few days ago a bag of fine powder had even jolted open.

pairs.target: tā zhǐ gěi tāmen kān ménkǎn shàng fāliàng de dìfāng . nàlǐ bèi lúnzǐ mó dé guānghuá , zhōngjiān liú zhe yídào qiǎn cáo .
pairs.english: She showed them the shiny spot on the threshold. Wheels had worn it smooth, leaving a shallow groove in the middle.

pairs.english: Farther out, a short stretch of wooden roadway joined the stone yard. The boards were very dark, with old leaves wedged in the edge gaps.
pairs.hanzi: 再往外是一小段木板路，连接院里的石地，木板颜色很深，边缝里塞着旧叶子。

pairs.english: Teacher Vey told them to watch two runs first, without inserting the student cart. Everyone waited behind the white line for the next one.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他们先看两趟，不拿学生车插进去。大家站在白线后，等下一辆。

pairs.english: The second cart was empty and quiet; its pusher did not draw in his shoulder either. The third had larger wheels and goods stacked high.
pairs.hanzi: 第二辆是空的，声音轻，推车的人也没缩肩。第三辆轮子大些，货叠得高，

pairs.english: As it passed outside the door, a topmost bag bounced lightly once, then immediately settled. The carter did not stop; plainly he was already used to lifting his hands a little.
pairs.hanzi: 走到门外时，最上面一只袋子轻轻跳了一下，立刻又稳住了。车夫没有停，他显然已经习惯把手往上提一点。

pairs.english: Tavi could make out the movement, but could not say for certain whether it happened on the threshold or after passing it. “I will watch another run,” he said.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维看得出这个动作，却说不准是在门槛上，还是过了门槛以后。
“我再看一趟。”他说。

pairs.english: Mira wanted to measure first. Seeing the teacher nod, she drew back the ruler and crouched beside him.

pairs.english: When the fourth cart passed, Tavi finally saw the left wheel drop at the outer end of the wooden roadway, two steps farther than the threshold they had been staring at all along.
pairs.hanzi: 第四辆走过时，塔维终于看见左轮落下去的那一下，在木板路的外端，比他们一直盯着的门槛远了两步。

pairs.english: He pointed, but Mira was looking the other way and missed it. The two did not immediately argue.
pairs.hanzi:
他指过去，米拉却正看另一边，没看见。
两人没有立刻争。

pairs.english: Lasha came up behind them, in no hurry to reach out and touch the boards either. She asked the manager whether water collected here after rain.
pairs.hanzi: 菈莎走到他们身后，也没急着伸手摸木板。她问仓管，这一段雨后会不会积水，

pairs.english: The manager said yes. When rushing goods through, they swept it toward the yard edge with a broom; the end by the wall was always slow to dry.

pairs.english: “Has it always been like this?” “Two boards were replaced last year. It was good for a while afterward. Then the noise came back.”
pairs.hanzi:
“原来就这样？”
“去年换过两块，换完好一阵。后来又响。”

pairs.english: Mira noted that timing beside the drawing. Tavi suddenly felt the threshold before him had not grown smaller, yet the area they needed to examine had grown much larger all at once.

pairs.english: They did not use warehouse goods to make up the load or ask the people busy moving sacks to push for them.
pairs.hanzi: 没有拿货仓的货来充数，也没有叫忙着搬袋的人替他们推。

pairs.english: Tavi and Lohen shared the lifting of the sandbags, then stepped back together once they were placed. Lohen glanced at his shoes and said the right lace was nearly undone.

pairs.english: Tavi crouched to retie it. Only as he stood did he realize his earlier self would probably have said it made no difference.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下重系，起身时才想起先前的自己大概会说，不影响。

pairs.english: They secured the recording box in the center, in the same position as during practice. Mira checked with her ruler; Iven wrote down the weather, ground conditions, and wheel dimensions.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把记录盒固定在中央，位置和练习时一致。米拉拿尺确认，伊文写上天气、地面和车轮尺寸。

pairs.english: At the threshold, the wooden box rattled once. Two more steps forward, the cart handle suddenly thrust upward in his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 车到门槛，木盒响了一下。再往前两步，手里的车把忽然向上一顶。

pairs.english: He did not reach to hold down the box. Keeping a firm grip on the handle, he pushed on and stopped only on the level ground the teacher had designated.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有去按住箱子，握稳车把，推到老师指定的平地才停。

pairs.english: The paper strip held two tangles of lines. Seeing the second was messier, Tavi felt his heartbeat quicken a little, as though he had finally understood something someone had said twice.
pairs.hanzi: 纸条上有两团线。塔维看见第二团更乱，心跳快了一点，像终于听懂一个人说了两遍的话。

pairs.english: But Mira first pointed at the fastening strap and asked, “Did this side come loose just now?” Tavi looked down. The strap end had indeed shifted a little.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉却先指着固定带问：“这边刚才是不是松了？”
塔维低头。带尾确实挪出一点。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xiǎng shuō dehuà yàn huíqù . wéi lǎoshī jiào tāmen bǎ zhè yìzhāng dāndú shōu hǎo , xiān xiūxi hēshuǐ , zài chá .
pairs.english: He swallowed what he had wanted to say. Teacher Vey told them to keep this sheet separately, rest and drink water first, then check.
pairs.hanzi: 他把想说的话咽回去。维老师叫他们把这一张单独收好，先休息喝水，再查。

pairs.target: yuàn biān zhōu pénglǐ yǒurén qiāo wǎn hǎn tiānshuǐ , chēdào zànshí ānjìng , mùbǎn fènglǐ de yèzi réng shī zhe .
pairs.english: In the porridge stall at the yard edge someone tapped a bowl and called for more water. The cart lane was quiet for the moment; the leaves in the board gaps were still wet.
pairs.hanzi: 院边粥棚里有人敲碗喊添水，车道暂时安静，木板缝里的叶子仍湿着。
